ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.

ElementDescription: Sex of subject at birth
Notes: M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Family level ID how it is defined in the lab/project. Same family ID used for parent and adolescent
Timepoint out of four assessments: Time 1 (baseline) - Time 2 (8-month follow-up) - Time 3 (16-month follow-up) - Time 4 (24-month follow-up)
Notes: 1=Baseline; 2=8-month follow-up; 3=16-month follow-up; 4=24-month follow-up

ElementDescription: Have you ever sipped/tasted alcohol?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Age at first sip?
Notes: 1=3 years old or less; 2=4 years old; 3=5 years old; 4=6 years old; 5=7 years old; 6=8 years old; 7=9 years old; 8=10 years old; 9=11 or 12 years old; 10=13 or 14 years old; 11=15 or 16 years old; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Type of alcoholic beverage?
Notes: 1=Beer; 2=Wine cooler/beer substitute; 3=Shots of distilled spirits/drinking out of the bottle; 4=Mixed drink; 5=Wine/champagne; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Continued to drink the beverage after sip?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Beverage belonged to someone of legal drinking age?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Whose beverage was it?
Notes: 1=Mom; 2=Dad; 3=Other guardian; 4=Uncle/aunt; 5=Other adult family member; 6=Other adult, non-family member; 7=Don't know the person; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: How was the beverage obtained?
Notes: 1=Offered to you; 2=Intentionally took it; 3=Accidentally took it; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Where did the sipping take place?
Notes: 1=At a party/social gathering at my house; 2=At a party/social gathering at someone else's house; 3=At an informal gathering at my house; 4=At an informal gathering at someone else's house; 5=At a restaurant or bar; 6=Outdoors (park, beach, stadium, parking lot, open field); 7=At a special occasion (e.g.a wedding, holiday); 8=At a religious ceremony such as in church or at a Seder dinner; 9=House-unspecified; 10=Other [a_sip_q7_oth]; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Where did the sipping take place? Specify other:
Do you remember when this (sipping) happened (vs. told about it later)?
Notes: 1=Yes, I remembered; 2=No, I did not remember. I was told about it later; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Since this first sip...Parents offered you a sip of their alcoholic beverage?
Notes: 1=No; 2=Yes, and I took a sip; 3=Yes, but I chose not to take a sip; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Since this first sip...You asked parents if you can have a sip of their beverage?
Notes: 1=No; 2=Yes, and they always say yes; 3=Yes, and they sometimes say yes; 4=Yes, and they always say no; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Since this first sip...You intentionally sipped parent's beverage without them knowing?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Since this first sip...Adults other than parents offered sips of their beverages?
Notes: 1=No; 2=Yes, and I took a sip; 3=Yes, but I chose not to take a sip; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Since this first sip...You asked other adults if you can have a sip of their beverage?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: Since this first sip...You intentionally sipped other adults' beverage without them knowing?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: How many times in your life did you sip/taste alcohol with the permission of your parents?
Notes: 1=0 Times; 2=1 Time; 3=2 Times; 4=3 times; 5=4 Times; 6=5 Times; 7=6 Times; 8=7 Time; 9=8 Times; 10=9 Times; 11=10 times; 12=More than 10 times; 99=Prefer not to answer

ElementDescription: At what age did you first sip alcohol with your parents' permission?
Notes: 1=Younger than 9 years old; 2=10 years old; 3=11 years old; 4=12 years old; 5=13 years old; 6=14 years old; 7=15 years old; 8=16 years old; 9=I did not sip alcohol with my parents permission; 99=Prefer not to answer
